# Helper to evaluate the simple year-increment formulas in Lookup!A2:A12
def get_lookup_year(row):
    v = ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("="):

        return get_lookup_year(row - 1) + 1

        return int(v)

total_expenses_row = 14

    val = ws_data.cell(row=year_header_row, column=col).value
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        year_cols.append((int(val), col))

for i, (year, start_col) in enumerate(year_cols):
    end_col = (year_cols[i + 1][1] - 1) if i + 1 < len(year_cols) else ws_data.max_column
    found_value = ""
    for col in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        v = ws_data.cell(row=total_expenses_row, column=col).value
        if v is not None:
            found_value = v
            break
    year_to_total_expenses[year] = found_value

# Modify only Lookup!B2:B12 as required.
for row in range(2, 13):
    year = get_lookup_year(row)
    ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=2).value = year_to_total_expenses.get(year, "")
